# TSBS DevOps — Metrics by Region

```{tags} reference, query-template, tsbs_devops
```

> [TSBS DevOps](../../tsbs-devops.md) benchmark · [all TSBS DevOps queries](index.md)

CPU metrics filtered by region

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  t.region,
  AVG(c.usage_user) AS avg_cpu_user,
  AVG(c.usage_system) AS avg_cpu_system
FROM cpu AS c
JOIN tags AS t
  ON c.hostname = t.hostname
WHERE
  c.time >= '2024-01-01 14:00:00'
  AND c.time < '2024-01-01 15:00:00'
  AND t.region = 'ap-southeast-1'
GROUP BY
  t.region
```
